teaser.en: Before felling a giant fig like this, tree cutters might first sacrifice a black sheep to the spirits living inside it.
teaser.sw: Kabla ya kuangusha mkuyu mkubwa kama huu, wakataji miti wanaweza kwanza kuchinja kondoo mweusi kama sadaka kwa pepo wanaoishi ndani yake.
teaser.dg: Kabla ya kukata muhi mkulu wa kuyu dza hinyu, akata mihi anaweza kulavya sadaka ya ng'ondzi mwiru kpwa pepho anaokala ndaniwe.

summary.en: *Mgandi*, the sycamore fig, is a massive spreading fig of riverbanks, groundwater sites and kaya forests, with figs clustered right on its trunk. Its fruit, shade and medicine make it useful, but big figs are also among the trees the Digo believe are home to spirits.
summary.sw: *Mgandi*, au mkuyu, ni mtini mkubwa unaotanda wa kingo za mito, maeneo ya maji ya chini ya ardhi na misitu ya kaya, wenye tini zilizosongamana moja kwa moja kwenye shina lake. Matunda, kivuli na dawa zake huufanya kuwa na manufaa, lakini mitini mikubwa pia ni miongoni mwa miti ambayo Wadigo wanaamini ni makazi ya pepo.
summary.dg: *Mgandi* ni muhi mkulu sana wa jamii ya kuyu, unaotandazika kanda-kanda ya miho, phatu phenye madzi ga tsini, na matsaka ga kaya, na matundage ganamera kpwa mafungu kpwenye kolo. Matundage, pephoye na dawaye vinaufwahisa, ela mihi mikulu ya jamii ya kuyu ni kahi ya mihi ambayo Adigo anaamini ni makalo ga pepho.

about.en:
*Mgandi* is a big tree in every sense: a heavy trunk, a broad spreading crown and limbs that can shade a whole gathering. The bark is yellowish and flakes away in patches, and any cut or broken twig bleeds a milky latex, as with all figs. The leaves are rounded and rough to the touch.

The most striking feature is where the fruit grows. Instead of hanging among the leaves, the small figs are borne in clusters directly on the trunk and the main branches, so a fruiting tree looks as if it has been studded with beads. Like all figs, the 'fruit' is really a hollow flower head, pollinated from the inside by tiny fig wasps.
about.sw:
*Mgandi* ni mti mkubwa kwa kila hali: shina zito, taji pana linalotanda na matawi yanayoweza kutoa kivuli kwa mkusanyiko mzima wa watu. Gome lake ni la manjano kidogo na hubanduka kwa mabaka, na kitawi chochote kilichokatwa au kuvunjika hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa, kama ilivyo kwa mitini yote. Majani yake ni ya mviringo na yanakwaruza yakiguswa.

Jambo la kushangaza zaidi ni mahali matunda yanapoota. Badala ya kuning'inia katikati ya majani, tini ndogo huzaliwa kwa vishada moja kwa moja kwenye shina na matawi makuu, hivyo mti unaozaa huonekana kana kwamba umepambwa kwa shanga. Kama tini zote, 'tunda' kwa hakika ni kichwa cha maua chenye uwazi ndani, kinachochavushwa kutoka ndani na nyigu wadogo sana wa tini.
about.dg:
*Mgandi* ni muhi mkulu kpwa chila njira: kolo kulu ziho, dari pana inayotandazika, na magongo ganayoweza kulavya pepho kpwa borori zima ra atu. Gophare ni ra rangi ya mandano na rinatuluka vipande-vipande, na chila phatu phanaphokatwa au chigongo chichivundzika phanatuluka maziya, dza kuyu zosi. Makodzage ni ga duara na ganakaraza uchiganguta.

Chitu cha ajabu zaidi ni phatu matunda ganaphomera. Badala ya kugbwadzika kahi ya makodza, kuyu ndide zinamera kpwa mafungu kpwenye kolo na magongo makulu, kpwa hivyo muhi wenye matunda unaonekana dza ukatiywa ushanga. Dza kuyu zosi, 'tunda' kpwa kpweli ni chitswa cha maruwa chirichokala na pango ndani, na chinachavushwa kula ndani ni adudu adide sana a kuyu.

where.en: Look for *mgandi* where there is water close to the surface: along rivers and streams, in riverine forest and at groundwater sites on the coastal plain. Large old trees also stand in the kaya forests, where they have been protected along with the rest of the sacred woodland. A fig in fruit is easiest to spot by the birds, bats and monkeys that gather to feed on it.
where.sw: Tafuta *mgandi* mahali ambapo maji yako karibu na uso wa ardhi: kando ya mito na vijito, katika misitu ya kingo za mito na kwenye maeneo ya maji ya chini ya ardhi katika tambarare ya pwani. Miti mikubwa ya zamani pia imesimama katika misitu ya kaya, ambako imelindwa pamoja na msitu mtakatifu wote. Mtini unaozaa ni rahisi zaidi kuutambua kwa ndege, popo na nyani wanaokusanyika kula matunda yake.
where.dg: Uchilonda *mgandi*, endza phatu ambapho madzi ga tsini ganaphahikana phephi na dzulu: kanda-kanda ya miho mikulu na midide, ndani ya matsaka ga kanda-kanda ya miho, na phatu phenye madzi ga tsini kpwenye herera ya pwani. Mihi mikulu ya kare piya inaima ndani ya matsaka ga kaya, ambamo yarindwa phamwenga na tsakare rosi takatifu. Kuyu yenye matunda ni rahisi kuimanya kpwa nyuni, manundu na tumbiri anaokusanyika kurya matundage.

uses.en:
The figs are edible and are picked straight from the trunk. The tree's wide crown makes it a favourite shade tree, a place to rest or meet out of the midday sun.

Both the latex and the bark are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Tini zake huliwa na huchumwa moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina. Taji lake pana huufanya kuwa mti wa kivuli unaopendwa, mahali pa kupumzika au kukutana mbali na jua la mchana.

Utomvu na gome lake vyote hutumika katika dawa za asili.
uses.dg:
Matunda ganariwa, na nkuhundwa kula kolo. Dari pana ya muhi hinyu inaufwahisa kukala muhi unaomendzwa kpwa pepho, phatu pha kuoya au kukutana na kuhepa dzuwa ra namutsi.

Maziya na gopha vyosi viiri nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji.

culture.en: Big fig trees are among the trees the Digo believe house spirits. Pakia records that tree cutters may sacrifice a black sheep before felling a large tree, to settle with whatever lives in it. Figs also have a place at the heart of the kaya: the *moroni*, the meeting house in the central clearing, is described as sitting between a fig tree and a baobab.
culture.sw: Mitini mikubwa ni miongoni mwa miti ambayo Wadigo wanaamini ni makazi ya pepo. Pakia anarekodi kwamba wakataji miti wanaweza kuchinja kondoo mweusi kama sadaka kabla ya kuangusha mti mkubwa, ili kupatana na chochote kinachoishi ndani yake. Mitini pia ina nafasi katikati ya kaya: *moroni*, nyumba ya mikutano katika uwanja wa katikati, inaelezwa kuwa iko kati ya mtini na mbuyu.
culture.dg: Mihi mikulu ya jamii ya kuyu ni kahi ya mihi ambayo Adigo anaamini ni makalo ga pepho. Pakia anaandika kukala akata mihi anaweza kulavya sadaka ya ng'ondzi mwiru kabla ya kukata muhi mkulu, ili kupatana na chochosi chinachokala ndaniwe. Kuyu piya zina phatu kahi-kahi ya kaya: *moroni*, nyumba ya mikutano iriyo kahi-kahi ya uwanja wa kaya, nkugombwa kukala i kahi ya muhi wa kuyu na muuyu.

names.en: Pakia gives the Digo name *mgandi* for *Ficus sycomorus*, the sycamore fig. In Swahili it is *mkuyu*. The Mgombato dictionary also lists *mgandi* with the Swahili *mkuyu*, but identifies it as the Cape fig, *Ficus sur*, a related fig that Pakia calls *mkuyu* in Digo. The two sources may be using the name for different fig species, and a speaker's check would settle which tree *mgandi* names today.
names.sw: Pakia anatoa jina la Kidigo *mgandi* kwa *Ficus sycomorus*, yaani *sycamore fig*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkuyu*. Kamusi ya Mgombato pia inaorodhesha *mgandi* pamoja na Kiswahili *mkuyu*, lakini inautambua kama *Cape fig*, *Ficus sur*, mtini wa jamii yake ambao Pakia anauita *mkuyu* kwa Kidigo. Huenda vyanzo hivi viwili vinatumia jina hili kwa spishi tofauti za mitini, na uthibitisho kutoka kwa mzungumzaji ungeamua ni mti upi unaoitwa *mgandi* leo.
names.dg: Pakia analavya dzina ra Chidigo *mgandi* kpwa *Ficus sycomorus*, kuyu ya *sycamore fig*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkuyu*. Kamusi ya Mgombato piya inaandika *mgandi* na Chiswahili *mkuyu*, ela inaamba kukala ni *Cape fig*, *Ficus sur*, kuyu yanjina ya jamii mwenga ambayo Pakia anaiiha *mkuyu* kpwa Chidigo. Vitabu hivi viiri vinaweza kukala vinahumira dzina hiri kpwa aina za tafwauti za kuyu, na mutu anayegomba Chidigo ndiye anayeweza kuamuwa ni muhi wani unaoihwa *mgandi* rero.

reason.en: Closely related fig; Mgombato links the two names
reason.sw: Mtini wa jamii ya karibu; Mgombato inayaunganisha majina haya mawili
reason.dg: Kuyu ya jamii ya phephi; Mgombato inagbwiriza madzina higa mairi

reason.en: Another wild fig with useful latex
reason.sw: Mtini mwingine wa porini wenye utomvu wenye manufaa
reason.dg: Kuyu yanjina ya weruni yenye maziya ga kufwaha

reason.en: The sandpaper fig, a smaller relative
reason.sw: Msasa, mtini mdogo wa jamii yake

reason.en: The baobab, its partner beside the kaya moroni
reason.sw: Mbuyu, mwenzake kando ya moroni ya kaya

reason.en: Another giant of the fig family
reason.sw: Jitu jingine la familia ya mitini
reason.dg: Muhi mkulu wanjina wa jamii ya kuyu
